insurer: Cholamandalam MS General Insurance Company Limited

room_rent.display: Single AC room (₹1500/day for ₹1L SI; ₹3000/day for ₹2L SI)
room_rent.note: Single occupancy AC room for all SI except ₹1L (capped ₹1500/day) and ₹2L (capped ₹3000/day). Differential room rent deducted if higher category occupied.

icu.display: Covered up to SI (no separate cap stated)
icu.note: ICU charges covered as part of inpatient hospitalisation up to sum insured; no specific ICU sub-limit mentioned.

copayment.note: 10% co-pay on all claims for insured persons above 55 years under Value Healthline plan. 20% co-pay if treatment taken in Tier-1 location but premium paid for Tier-2 location.

sub_limits.display: Maternity capped ₹1L/delivery (Privilege only); ambulance fixed limits
sub_limits.note: Maternity limited to ₹1L per delivery under Privilege plan. Ambulance: ₹1000 (Value), ₹2000 (Freedom/Freedom), ₹5000 (Privilege). No other disease-wise sub-limits stated.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents exempt.

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period is 36 months from inception; no optional reduction mentioned.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Listed conditions (cataract, hernia, varicose veins, arthritis, stones, etc.) excluded for first 24 months.

maternity.note: Available only under Privilege Healthline plan after 3 consecutive renewals (36 months). Limit ₹1L per delivery, up to 2 deliveries lifetime. Newborn cover included.

cumulative_bonus.display: Up to 100% (Enrich/Privilege); up to 50% (Freedom); up to 25% (Value)
cumulative_bonus.note: Value: 5%/yr max 25%; Freedom: 5%/yr max 50%; Enrich: 5%/yr max 100%; Privilege: 50%/yr max 50% of SI. Bonus reduced on claim.

restoration.note: No sum insured restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the base policy. Double Sum Insured available under Enrich/Privilege for critical illness and accidents only.

pre_hosp.note: Value Healthline: 30 days. Freedom, Enrich, Privilege: 60 days.

post_hosp.note: Value Healthline: 60 days. Freedom, Enrich, Privilege: 90 days.

day_care.note: Extensive listed day-care procedures covered; cashless at network hospitals; pre-auth required for non-network.

domiciliary.note: Covered if condition requires hospitalisation but patient cannot be moved or no room available. Minimum 2 days treatment required. No cashless.

ayush.note: AYUSH hospitalisation (24hrs+) and day-care covered up to sum insured at recognised AYUSH hospitals/day-care centres.

organ_donor.note: Organ donor harvesting expenses covered; donor pre/post-hospitalisation not covered.

ambulance.note: Fixed per-hospitalisation limits vary by plan: Value ₹1000, Freedom/Enrich ₹2000, Privilege ₹5000.

modern_treatments.note: No specific exclusion or sub-limit for modern/robotic treatments; covered under inpatient hospitalisation up to SI.

consumables.display: Not covered (base); Optional via Home Care add-on
consumables.note: Non-medical consumables excluded per Annexure 2. Home Care Treatment add-on covers listed consumables for home treatment.

global_cover.note: Policy covers treatment within India only (Indian Rupees, Indian territory).

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months, claims cannot be contested except on grounds of fraud.

grace_period.note: 15 days grace for monthly premium mode; 30 days for all other payment modes.

free_look.note: 30-day free-look from receipt of policy document for new policies; not applicable on renewals or porting.

portability.note: IRDAI-compliant portability with continuity of waiting period credits.

notable_exclusions.display: STDs, circumcision (non-medical), external congenital anomalies, durable medical equipment, refractive error <7.5D, non-medical consumables (Annexure 2)

optional_riders.display: Medical Second Opinion (WLMC), Flexi OP Care (OPD consultations/diagnostics), Home Care Treatment add-on
